values.note: Book online through Nassau County's parks catalog; payment due at booking and 'All Reservations are Non Refundable'. Reservations are 'subject to change and approval by Battle Row Campground Staff'. No RV may stay on one site more than 14 consecutive days; after that a new site must be booked in advance. Anyone may book; the resident rate needs a valid Nassau Leisure Pass and a camper registered in Nassau County. Check each site's length before booking.

booking.source: https://www.nassaucountyny.gov/2811/Battle-Row-Campground ('To book a campsite ... click on the link below'; 'All payments are due upon booking'; 'All Reservations are Non Refundable'; 'All reservations are subject to change and approval by Battle Row Campground Staff'; 'No camper or RV can be booked for more than 14 consecutive days on the same site'; 'You must have a valid leisure pass and the camper must be registered in Nassau County to receive resident discounts'; 'Please check each site before booking for length requirements'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Open all year for RV camping only.

values.note: 52 RV sites with water and electric; 12 tent sites, strictly tents (no campers or RVs), reserved by campers 21 or older. Lengths vary by site, up to 40 ft. 44 acres of campground and dense woods; a rally field for club group camping.

sites.source: https://www.nassaucountyny.gov/2811/Battle-Row-Campground ('64 campsites ranging in length from up to 40 feet'; '12 tent sites (must be 21 years of age or older to reserve)'; 'Tent camping sites are strictly for tent camping. No campers or RVs are permitted'; 'a rally field for club group camping'), read 2026-10-21

note: Nassau County park campground in Old Bethpage, handy for New York City by train from Hicksville. --Claude
summary: County page confirms 64 sites to 40 ft, 52 with water + 30/50 A electric, year-round RV season, online booking, 14-day limit, phone 516-572-8690; adds showers, non-refundable/staff-approved booking, and that non-residents may book (resident rate needs a Leisure Pass). Fees left as read from the county catalog 2026-10-11 ($34/$39 resident, +$30 otherwise). Not stated: minimum stay (the catalog is script-only). Note: dropped site/hookup/season/booking restatements.
